lines.sky.title: SKY
lines.sky.tagline: FLIGHT SCHOOL OVER THE ISLE OF GULLS
lines.sky.goal.plane: FLY THROUGH THE RINGS, THEN LAND
lines.sky.goal.dive: THROUGH THE HOOPS, ONTO THE TARGET
lines.sky.goal.belt: THROUGH THE RINGS, THEN THE PAD
lines.sky.goal.glider: RIDE THE THERMALS, THEN THE TARGET
lines.sky.heli.pad: ALL DESTROYED: BACK TO THE PAD
lines.sky.hud.thermal: TOO LOW: CIRCLE IN A THERMAL

notes.sky.title: The flight game's title, on its menu.
notes.sky.tagline: Under the title: a flight school over an island called the Isle of Gulls.
notes.sky.menu.plane: An event: fly a small propeller plane.
notes.sky.menu.dive: An event: jump from a plane with a parachute.
notes.sky.menu.voyage: An event: fly an airship (a blimp) over the world.
notes.sky.menu.back: Back to the title screen (a menu entry).
notes.sky.menu.again: After an event: fly the same event again.
notes.sky.menu.menu: After an event: back to this game's menu.
notes.sky.event.plane: The light plane event's name, in the corner while flying.
notes.sky.event.dive: The skydiving event's name, in the corner while falling.
notes.sky.event.voyage: The airship event's name, in the corner while flying.
notes.sky.goal.plane: Shown as the plane event starts: fly through every ring in the sky, then land on the runway.
notes.sky.goal.dive: Shown as the dive starts: fall through the hoops, then land on the round target on the ground.
notes.sky.goal.voyage: Shown as the voyage starts: light three beacon towers by landing beside each.
notes.sky.final: After the last ring: turn so the plane points along the runway.
notes.sky.hard: Touched the runway too fast, too steep or not lined up: a crash.
notes.sky.crash: Hit the ground or the sea away from the runway.
notes.sky.late: The parachute opened very low, by itself.
notes.sky.voyage.lit: A beacon tower now burns; {n} is how many are lit.
notes.sky.voyage.done: Landed back at the castle you started from: the end of the voyage.
notes.sky.hud.rings: How many rings were flown through, {n}, of {of}.
notes.sky.hud.beacons: How many beacons are lit, {n}, of three.
notes.sky.hud.alt: The height above the ground, {m} metres.
notes.sky.hud.open: A prompt: {key} is the key or button that opens the parachute.
notes.sky.hud.home: The compass's goal: the castle, {m} metres away.
notes.sky.hud.beacon: The compass's goal: the nearest unlit beacon, {m} metres away.
notes.sky.hud.land: A prompt by a beacon: {key} lands the airship.
notes.sky.hud.lower: Near a beacon but too high to land: go lower.
notes.sky.hud.flare: Advice for the landing: come down slowly, wings level.
notes.sky.part.rings: The results: points for the rings.
notes.sky.part.landing: The results: points for the landing.
notes.sky.part.chute: The results: points for opening the parachute at the right height.
notes.sky.part.time: The results: points for how fast the voyage was.
notes.sky.total: The results: the score out of 100, {n}.
notes.sky.best: The best score yet at this event, {n}.
notes.sky.medal.gold: The top medal, for 90 points or more.
notes.sky.medal.silver: The second medal, for 75 or more.
notes.sky.medal.bronze: The third medal, for 55 or more.
notes.action.gas: A control's name (the settings' controls and the touch button): more throttle, or the helicopter climbing.
notes.action.slow: A control's name: less throttle, a parachute's brake, the glider's air brake, or the helicopter coming down.
notes.action.act: A control's name: open the parachute, land the airship, or fire the helicopter's missile.
notes.sky.menu.belt: An event: fly a jet pack strapped to your back.
notes.sky.event.belt: The rocket belt event's name, in the corner while flying.
notes.sky.goal.belt: Shown as the rocket belt event starts: fly through the low rings, then land on the landing pad.
notes.sky.belt.pad: The rocket belt, after the last ring: now land softly on the square pad.
notes.sky.hud.fuel: The rocket belt's fuel, beside its gauge.
notes.sky.menu.glider: An event: fly a hang glider (a wing with no engine, the pilot hanging under it).
notes.sky.menu.heli: An event: fly a helicopter that fires missiles at gun turrets.
notes.sky.event.glider: The hang glider event's name, in the corner while flying.
notes.sky.event.heli: The helicopter event's name, in the corner while flying.
notes.sky.goal.glider: Shown as the hang glider event starts: climb in the columns of rising warm air (thermals), fly through the rings, then land on the round target.
notes.sky.goal.heli: Shown as the helicopter event starts: destroy the five anti-aircraft turrets, then land back on the pad.
notes.sky.glider.target: The hang glider, after the last ring: now land on the round target.
notes.sky.heli.boom: A missile destroyed one of the gun turrets.
notes.sky.heli.pad: Every turret is destroyed: now land the helicopter on the square pad it took off from.
notes.sky.heli.hit: The helicopter was hit by a flak shot from a turret.
notes.sky.heli.down: The helicopter took its third hit and falls: the event is over.
notes.sky.hud.climb: The glider's variometer: rising at {v} metres a second.
notes.sky.hud.sink: The glider's variometer: sinking at {v} metres a second.
notes.sky.hud.stall: A warning: the glider is too slow to fly and drops its nose. Short.
notes.sky.hud.thermal: Advice: the next ring is higher than the glider; circle inside a thermal (a column of rising air) to climb.
notes.sky.hud.turrets: How many gun turrets still stand, {n}.
notes.sky.hud.damage: Beside three boxes that turn red as the helicopter is hit (three hits and it falls).
notes.sky.hud.lift: A prompt on the pad: {key} is the key or button that makes the helicopter climb.
notes.sky.part.soft: The results: points for touching down gently.
notes.sky.part.turrets: The results: points for the turrets destroyed.
notes.sky.part.damage: The results: points for the hits the helicopter did not take.
notes.sky.touch.fire: The helicopter's touch button that fires a missile: short.
